# Goyal Consultancy

> Strategic Financial Governance & Enterprise ESG Disclosures. Where Fiscal Precision Meets Sustainable Intelligence.

Goyal Consultancy is a premier executive advisory firm providing corporate tax architecture, statutory compliance, and enterprise ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) consulting to C-suite leadership (CEOs, CFOs, CSOs), board committees, and institutional enterprises. Goyal Consultancy bridges traditional statutory financial rigor with modern sustainability compliance through its proprietary enterprise software platform, ESG DataVault (https://esgdatavault.online).

---

## Core Practice Areas

### 1. Financial Consulting & Corporate Tax Architecture
- **Corporate Tax Planning**: Forward-looking tax optimization, holding company structuring, allowance maximization, and cross-border liability management.
- **Statutory Tax Filing & Compliance**: Advance tax forecasting, corporate income tax returns (ITR-1 through ITR-7), TDS reconciliations, and regulatory e-filing.
- **Financial Modeling & Capital Restructuring**: Capital allocation, valuation, dividend strategies, and cash flow governance.
- **Tax Audit & Assessment Representation**: Complete statutory audit defense, transfer pricing documentation, faceless assessments, and tribunal appeals.

### 2. ESG Consulting & Sustainability Regulatory Disclosures
- **SEBI BRSR & BRSR Core Compliance**: End-to-end alignment across all 9 Principles and the 49 mandatory BRSR Core KPIs for top listed companies under SEBI regulations in India.
- **Global Sustainability Frameworks**: Multi-framework alignment across GRI Standards, ISSB S1/S2 (IFRS Sustainability Standards), and EU CSRD/ESRS requirements.
- **Materiality & Emissions Strategy**: Stakeholder materiality surveys, climate risk assessments, Scope 1, 2, and 3 GHG emissions inventories, and net-zero roadmaps.
- **Third-Party Assurance Preparation**: Pre-assurance data packet preparation, verifiable calculation sheets, and audit trail generation for statutory verification partners.

### 3. Proprietary Technology: ESG DataVault
- **URL**: https://esgdatavault.online
- **Function**: Structured data infrastructure and AI-powered data intake platform for sustainability teams.
- **Core Capabilities**:
  - Automated spreadsheet parsing and sub-agent AI cell mapping.
  - Multi-tenant tenant isolation with role-based access control (Admin, User, SuperAdmin, Auditor).
  - Computed field formula engine (A * B / C across dimensions: geography, gender, facility).
  - Real-time compliance gap analysis and data status matrix.
  - Audit-ready board report generation with Google Gemini-assisted narrative drafting.
